entry.title: The Government of Canada highlights doubling of compliance monetary penalties under the Temporary Foreign Worker Program
entry.summary: The federal government is focused on building lasting economic strength. This starts right here at home.

entry.title: Government of Canada taking action to support rural employers under the Temporary Foreign Worker Program
entry.summary: Strong local businesses and a reliable workforce are essential to keeping rural economies growing and communities thriving across Canada. Canadians must always be first in line for available jobs. However, in regions experiencing severe labour shortages, the Temporary Foreign Worker (TFW) Program allows employers to hire foreign workers to address critical, short-term workforce gaps when qualified Canadians or permanent residents are not available.
